description.en: Same as RemovePartyNum_Message, but without fading/stopping the current BGM (passes 0 for both the fade and wait durations).
Array of param IDs, one per member to remove.
Array of status-reset flags, one per member.
Optional; when true, removes members without locking their slot (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Remove several party members in sequence without fading the BGM
RemovePartyNum_Message_NoFadeBGM(_rmv_num, _aParamID, _aStReset, _not_pt_lock);
